title: Inkling-2-Mini
summary: Inkling-2-Mini on one DGX Spark (GB10, 128 GB) at TP=1 with gr8 and bundled DFlash speculative decoding: load-time width selection across k4 (-27.4% KL vs Official NVFP4, 93.54% on 1,362 tasks), bit325 (8/8 exact DFlash greedy parity, 3,484 tok/s 8K prefill), bit250, and k2 (up to 167.5 math / 230.0 C=6 / 479.5 6x math tok/s), with a 1,048,576-token (1M) KV pool.

configs.label: TP=1 · K4 (default)
configs.max_tokens_per_chat_note: 4 dedicated 262,144-token slabs (1M KV pool); CAP=131072 SESSIONS=8 (11.6 GiB free) and CAP=1048576 SESSIONS=1 (7.8 GiB free) also verified live
configs.notes: k4 experts (4.00 bpw, 18.72 GB device image) + bundled 279 MB DFlash drafter (MTP=7, auto-discovered). Default Docker Compose CAP=262144 SESSIONS=4 (1,048,576 total KV pool) verified live 2026-11-25 on ghcr.io/kindlingai/gr8:sha-6b87480 (10.3 s boot, 12.20 GiB MemAvailable after 146.4K needle PASS). 8-domain decode, C=6 mixed, and 8K cold prefill measured 2026-11-25 on 1x DGX Spark (gr8 PR #615, GR8_INK2_PF_MX8_MOE=2, GR8_INK2_MX8_DENSE=2, GR8_INK2_MX8_LM_HEAD=0).

configs.label: TP=1 · bit325

quality.name: DFlash K=7 vs MTP=0 greedy parity

configs.notes: bit325 experts (3.25 bpw, 16.43 GB device image) + bundled DFlash (MTP=7). Set VARIANT=bit325 in .env. Measured 2026-11-25 on 1x DGX Spark (gr8 PR #615). Thinking-ON prose (512 tok, t=0.6): c1 48.5 / c2 70.2 / c4 100.3 / c6 122.6 tok/s. Homogeneous 6x Math: 298.6 tok/s.
